title: City of Edmonton Policy 14-01-G: reduced or zero lot line side yard wall and gable construction for a detached garage
jurisdiction: Edmonton, Alberta (City of Edmonton Safety Codes, Permits and Inspections policy)
code_edition: Policy cites Alberta Building Code 2014 (ABC 2014) sentences and Standata G-01-10-Rev1; policy dated 10 January 2019

facts.text: The policy addresses reduced or zero lot line side yard wall and gable construction on a detached garage or accessory building serving a single detached or semi-detached house.

The policy states that an alternative solution is often required because building eaves are typically proposed projecting too close to, or over, a side property line. Code-compliant RZLL proposals do not need one.
The policy proposes a 'deemed limiting distance' and an option for acceptable construction details for side yard walls and gables, and states it does not preclude other solutions.

Under the POLICY paragraph, where the buildings would be less than 2.4 m apart, a deemed limiting distance line is set midway between the buildings instead of the property line. A minimum 1 h fire-resistance rated wall with Type X gypsum board on both sides applies in one described configuration.

The policy cites Standata G-01-10-Rev1 in a window-related requirement, and Alberta Building Code 2014 sentences including 1.4.1.2 (limiting distance definition) and Division C 2.2.5.2 (drawings must show enough detail to demonstrate conformance).
The policy lists options for construction other than in conformance with it, including a prescriptive compliant construction intention.
facts.locator: p.3 'Options to construct other than in conformance'

facts.text: The footer reads 'Content subject to periodic update. Ensure use of the most recent version.' with the date 10 January 2019.
The policy quotes an owner's or constructor's duty to provide written assurance from the person supervising construction, when the authority having jurisdiction requires it.

limitations: Municipal policy, not a permit application or decision. The prompt is a scenario based on the policy's own intent; no owner, site or dimension is supplied.
The policy cites ABC 2014 and is dated 10 Jan 2019. Any current-edition conclusion needs an NBC(AE) 2023 2nd-printing check that this file cannot provide.
The policy says its content is subject to periodic update; the current City version may differ from this copy.
Standata G-01-10-Rev1 and the Zoning Bylaw are cited but not attached.
